fields.name: ROW ID
fields.description: A unique sequential number, running from the first record to the last.

fields.name: BANK CODE
fields.description: Bank clearing code of the reporting bank as issued by Kenya Banker's Association (KBA)

fields.name: CUSTOMER PARTY ID
fields.description: Unique customer identifier as assigned to customers by the reporting institution.

fields.name: BUSINESS REPORTING DATE
fields.description: Date of report submission. Format {DD-MMM-YYYY}

fields.name: CATEGORY OF SECURITY
fields.description: This will denote whether a particular security is 'issued' or 'Purchased'. 'Issued' denotes securities issued by the reporting entity whereas 'Purchased' denotes securities purchased by the reporting entity.

fields.name: ULT BENEF NOMIN ACCT
fields.description: Nominee account number (CDS A/c)

fields.name: ULT BENEF TYPE
fields.description: Whether ultimate beneficiary is the bank or a client/nomiee

fields.name: COUNTRY OF ISSUE
fields.description: ISO country code

fields.name: SECURITY ISIN ISSUE NO
fields.description: International securities identification number for the security issued

fields.name: SECURITY LCL ISSUE NO
fields.description: Locally issued identification number for the security

fields.name: TYPE OF SECURITY
fields.description: Type of security e.g. (Treasury bill, Treasury bond, Commercial paper, Debenture, Bankers acceptance and corporate bonds, etc.)

fields.name: SECURITY ISSUER
fields.description: The name of the issuer of the security issued

fields.name: TENURE IN DAYS
fields.description: Secuirty tenure in number of days

fields.name: ISSUE DATE
fields.description: Security issue date. Format {DD-MMM-YYYY}

fields.name: MATURITY DATE
fields.description: Maturity date of the security. Format {DD-MMM-YYYY}

fields.name: COUPON RATE
fields.description: Coupon rate in percentage.

fields.name: FACE VALUE
fields.description: Face value amount for the security

fields.name: AMOUNT HELD
fields.description: Value of the security held in KES

fields.name: ULT BENEF SNA CLASS
fields.description: Classification as per SNA

fields.name: ULT BENEF CATEGORY
fields.description: Classification of investor i.e. Retail or Institutional/wholesale

fields.name: SOURCE CNTRY FREGN INVEST
fields.description: ISO currency codes as per ISO-4217. {e.g. USD, GPB, EUR, KES. etc.}

fields.name: SECURITIES CLASS
fields.description: Classification of securities as per IFRS 9 {Held to maturity (HTM), Held for Trading (HFT) and Available for sale (AFS)}
